# Editorial route

- Extract speaker audience purpose medium evidence needs emotion and hard limits from the request.
- Use `scripts/editorial_router.py` or its current interface when executable routing is required.
- Choose only publication packs supported by the repository.
- Preserve privacy legal factual and format limits as mandatory checks.
- Surface missing inputs that materially change routing rather than inventing them.
- Pass the selected pack evidence level emotion and required checks to the next stage.
- Add or update router evals when routing behavior changes.
